delivery_contract: Resolve every candidate observance to a 2026 Gregorian date.
Select exactly four observances under the provided policy and operating limits.
Preserve enough evidence for a reviewer to recheck each selected date.
Use the provisioned calendar dataset as the working source and keep the public reference files for cross-checks.
report_expectation: The handoff note should read like a schedule recommendation for studio operators, not like a raw data dump.
manual_review_prompts: Confirm venue staffing for the selected weekend dates.
Confirm weather fallback plans for outdoor-format events.
Confirm whether any local permit paperwork is needed before promotion.
